items.item_text: UC Davis Health is seeking a Board Certified/Board Eligible Obstetrician-Gynecologist to join our team as an OB/GYN Hospitalist. The OB/GYN Hospitalist provides dedicated, in-house obstetric and gynecologic coverage, ensuring immediate physician availability for laboring patients, obstetric emergencies, and unassigned gynecologic consultations. This role supports patient safety, improves continuity of care, and works collaboratively with community OB/GYN providers, residents, and the broader care team.
Provide in-house coverage for Labor & Delivery, triage, and emergency obstetric/gynecologic consultations
Manage unassigned and walk-in obstetric patients presenting for care
Respond to obstetric emergencies, including operative deliveries and emergent cesarean sections
Collaborate with community physicians to co-manage patients and ensure smooth handoffs
Supervise and teach residents and medical students as part of an academic medical center
Participate in quality improvement initiatives, patient safety committees, and departmental meetings
Maintain accurate and timely documentation in the electronic medical record
Participate in a structured shift schedule, including nights, weekends, and holidays as required
M.D. or D.O. degree from an accredited medical school
Board Certified or Board Eligible in Obstetrics & Gynecology (ABOG)
Current, unrestricted California medical license (or eligibility to obtain)
Experience in high-acuity obstetric and gynecologic emergency management preferred
Strong communication and collaboration skills within a multidisciplinary academic environment
What UC Davis Health Offers
Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits package
Academic appointment opportunities through UC Davis School of Medicine
Access to state-of-the-art facilities and a Level III/IV NICU (as applicable)
Collaborative, team-based practice environment
Support for continuing medical education and professional development
Relocation assistance available for qualified candidates

UC Davis Health is a premier academic health system serving inland Northern California, encompassing UC Davis Medical Center, the UC Davis School of Medicine, and a network of clinics. As a designated Level I Trauma Center and academic medical center, UC Davis Health is committed to excellence in patient care, research, education, and community engagement.
